function.name: hypothesis_testing_ttest_ind
function.description: Conducts a hypothesis test for two independent samples. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

message.reasoning:
We need to perform an independent t-test on two samples. We have sample1: [22,33,42,12,34], sample2: [23,45,44,14,38]. Significance level alpha=0.05.

We should call the function hypothesis_testing_ttest_ind with sample1 and sample2 arrays and significance_level=0.05. Then we need to interpret the result. The function likely returns some object containing p-value, t-statistic, degrees of freedom, etc. We need to produce a response in Chinese presumably. The user asked "進行兩個獨立樣本的假設檢定" meaning "conduct a hypothesis test for two independent samples". So we should provide the test statistic, degrees of freedom, p-value, and conclusion at alpha=0.05. Let's compute manually or approximate? Let's compute quickly:

Sample1: n1=5, values: 22,33,42,12,34. Sum=22+33+42+12+34=143. Mean1=143/5=28.6. Compute variance: sum((x - mean)^2). Differences: 22-28.6=-6.6; squared=43.56. 33-28.6=4.4; sq=19.36. 42-28.6=13.4; sq=179.56. 12-28.6=-16.6; sq=275.56. 34-28.6=5.4; sq=29.16. Sum squares=43.56+19.36+179.56+275.56+29.16=547.2. Sample variance s1^2 = sum/(n1-1)=547.2/4=136.8. Standard deviation s1=sqrt(136.8)=11.704.

Sample2: n2=5, values: 23,45,44,14,38. Sum=23+45+44+14+38=164. Mean2=164/5=32.8. Differences: 23-32.8=-9.8; sq=96.04. 45-32.8=12.2; sq=148.84. 44-32.8=11.2; sq=125.44. 14-32.8=-18.8; sq=353.44. 38-32.8=5.2; sq=27.04. Sum squares=96.04+148.84+125.44+353.44+27.04=750.8. Sample variance s2^2=750.8/4=187.7. Standard deviation s2=sqrt(187.7)=13.703.

Now compute pooled standard error: sqrt(s1^2/n1 + s2^2/n2) = sqrt(136.8/5 + 187.7/5) = sqrt(27.36 + 37.54) = sqrt(64.90) = 8.055. Actually check: 136.8/5=27.36; 187.7/5=37.54; sum=64.90; sqrt=8.056.

t-statistic = (mean1 - mean2)/SE = (28.6 - 32.8)/8.056 = (-4.2)/8.056 = -0.521. Degrees of freedom: using Welch's formula: df = (s1^2/n1 + s2^2/n2)^2 / ((s1^2/n1)^2/(n1-1) + (s2^2/n2)^2/(n2-1)). Compute numerator: (27.36+37.54)^2 = 64.90^2 = 4210.81. Denominator: (27.36^2)/(4) + (37.54^2)/(4) = (748.74)/4 + (1408.75)/4 = 187.185 + 352.188 = 539.373. df = 4210.81/539.373 = 7.806. Approximately 7.8 degrees of freedom.

Two-tailed p-value: For t = -0.521 with df ~7.8. Use t distribution. Roughly p > 0.6 maybe. Let's approximate: t critical for df=8 at alpha=0.05 two-tailed is about ±2.306. Our |t|=0.52 < 2.306, so fail to reject null. p-value around 0.61. So conclusion: no significant difference between means at alpha=0.05.
